description.value:
The outer rim of this high-tech magnifying glass is etched with occult symbols that grant it the ability to peer into the past with the right calibrations. Retrocognitive lenses can be made to augment other senses, most commonly smell, for use by blind creatures. You gain a +2 item bonus to Perception checks to [[/act seek]] and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Search] while using the lens.

Activation—Psychic Clues (concentrate, manipulate, occult) 1 minute

Frequency once per day

Effect By holding the lens up to one eye and adjusting its focus, you can see psychic impressions of events that occurred in your current vicinity over the course of the previous day. You can examine these echoes for 1 minute, gaining vague clues about what occurred during that time period. You gain a +2 item bonus to Perception checks to [[/act sense-motive]] for 24 hours when questioning creatures who were present or know what happened during that time. These clues come in the form of emotional remnants and cryptic symbolism rather than clear visions. At the GM's discretion, if you learn about a particularly traumatic event, you must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:34] save or become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 2} for 1 hour (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 3} on a critical failure).
